verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֑ים מִקֵּ֖ץ וּפַרְעֹ֣ה חֹלֵ֔ם וְהִנֵּ֖ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־ הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî šə·nā·ṯa·yim yā·mîm miq·qêṣ ū·p̄ar·‘ōh ḥō·lêm wə·hin·nêh ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- hay·’ōr
verses.literal: After two full years . . . had passed Pharaoh had a dream . . . He was standing beside the Nile

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת יְפ֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וּבְרִיאֹ֣ת בָּשָׂ֑ר עֹלֹת֙ מִן־ הַיְאֹ֗ר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ pā·rō·wṯ yə·p̄ō·wṯ mar·’eh ū·ḇə·rî·’ōṯ bā·śār ‘ō·lōṯ min- hay·’ōr wat·tir·‘e·nāh bā·’ā·ḥū
verses.literal: - when seven cows sleek . . . and well-fed . . . came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֞ה אַחֲרֵיהֶן֙ שֶׁ֧בַע אֲחֵר֗וֹת פָּר֣וֹת רָע֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וְדַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר עֹל֤וֹת מִן־ הַיְאֹ֔ר וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה אֵ֥צֶל הַפָּר֖וֹת עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’a·ḥă·rê·hen še·ḇa‘ ’ă·ḥê·rō·wṯ pā·rō·wṯ rā·‘ō·wṯ mar·’eh wə·ḏaq·qō·wṯ bā·śār ‘ō·lō·wṯ min- hay·’ōr wat·ta·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh ’ê·ṣel hap·pā·rō·wṯ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr
verses.literal: - After them seven other cows sickly . . . and thin . . . came up from the Nile and stood beside the [well-fed] cows on the bank of the river

verses.original: הַפָּר֗וֹת רָע֤וֹת הַמַּרְאֶה֙ וְדַקֹּ֣ת הַבָּשָׂ֔ר אֵ֚ת וַתֹּאכַ֣לְנָה שֶׁ֣בַע יְפֹ֥ת הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְהַבְּרִיאֹ֑ת הַפָּר֔וֹת פַּרְעֹֽה׃ וַיִּיקַ֖ץ
verses.transliteration: hap·pā·rō·wṯ rā·‘ō·wṯ ham·mar·’eh wə·ḏaq·qōṯ hab·bā·śār ’êṯ wat·tō·ḵal·nāh še·ḇa‘ yə·p̄ōṯ ham·mar·’eh wə·hab·bə·rî·’ōṯ hap·pā·rō·wṯ par·‘ōh way·yî·qaṣ
verses.literal: And the cows [that were] sickly . . . and thin . . . - devoured the seven sleek . . . well-fed cows Then Pharaoh woke up

verses.original: וַיִּישָׁ֕ן וַֽיַּחֲלֹ֖ם שֵׁנִ֑ית וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים בְּרִיא֥וֹת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃ עֹל֛וֹת אֶחָ֖ד בְּקָנֶ֥ה
verses.transliteration: way·yî·šān way·ya·ḥă·lōm šê·nîṯ wə·hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ šib·bo·lîm bə·rî·’ō·wṯ wə·ṭō·ḇō·wṯ ‘ō·lō·wṯ ’e·ḥāḏ bə·qā·neh
verses.literal: but he fell back asleep and dreamed a second time . . . Seven heads of grain plump and ripe came up on one stalk

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶֽן׃ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים צֹמְח֖וֹת דַּקּ֖וֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹ֣ת קָדִ֑ים
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’a·ḥă·rê·hen še·ḇa‘ šib·bo·lîm ṣō·mə·ḥō·wṯ daq·qō·wṯ ū·šə·ḏū·p̄ōṯ qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: - After them seven other heads of grain sprouted thin and scorched by the east wind

verses.original: הַדַּקּ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת הַשִּׁבֳּלִ֣ים וַתִּבְלַ֙עְנָה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע הַבְּרִיא֖וֹת וְהַמְּלֵא֑וֹת הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִ֔ים פַּרְעֹ֖ה וַיִּיקַ֥ץ וְהִנֵּ֥ה חֲלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: had·daq·qō·wṯ ’êṯ haš·šib·bo·lîm wat·tiḇ·la‘·nāh še·ḇa‘ hab·bə·rî·’ō·wṯ wə·ham·mə·lê·’ō·wṯ haš·šib·bo·lîm par·‘ōh way·yî·qaṣ wə·hin·nêh ḥă·lō·wm
verses.literal: And the thin - heads of grain swallowed up the seven plump ripe ones Then Pharaoh awoke and realized it was a dream

verses.original: בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַיְהִ֤י רוּח֔וֹ וַתִּפָּ֣עֶם וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־ כָּל־ חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י כָּל־ חֲכָמֶ֑יהָ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ פַּרְעֹ֤ה וַיְסַפֵּ֨ר לָהֶם֙ אֶת־ חֲלֹמ֔וֹ וְאֵין־ פּוֹתֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֖ם לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḇab·bō·qer way·hî rū·ḥōw wat·tip·pā·‘em way·yiš·laḥ way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- kāl- ḥar·ṭum·mê kāl- ḥă·ḵā·me·hā miṣ·ra·yim wə·’eṯ- par·‘ōh way·sap·pêr lā·hem ’eṯ- ḥă·lō·mōw wə·’ên- pō·w·ṯêr ’ō·w·ṯām lə·p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: In the morning . . . his spirit was troubled so he summoned . . . - all the magicians and wise men of Egypt - Pharaoh told them - his dreams but no one could interpret them for him

verses.original: שַׂ֣ר הַמַּשְׁקִ֔ים וַיְדַבֵּר֙ אֶת־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֶת־ הַיּֽוֹם׃ אֲנִ֖י מַזְכִּ֥יר חֲטָאַ֕י
verses.transliteration: śar ham·maš·qîm way·ḏab·bêr ’eṯ- par·‘ōh lê·mōr ’eṯ- hay·yō·wm ’ă·nî maz·kîr ḥă·ṭā·’ay
verses.literal: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh . . . - Today I recall my failures

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֖ה קָצַ֣ף עַל־ עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתִ֜י אֹתִ֕י וְאֵ֖ת שַׂ֣ר הָאֹפִֽים׃ בְּמִשְׁמַ֗ר בֵּ֚ית שַׂ֥ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh qā·ṣap̄ ‘al- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯî ’ō·ṯî wə·’êṯ śar hā·’ō·p̄îm bə·miš·mar bêṯ śar haṭ·ṭab·bā·ḥîm
verses.literal: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants and he put - me and the chief baker in the custody . . . of the captain of the guard

verses.original: אֶחָ֖ד בְּלַ֥יְלָה וָה֑וּא אֲנִ֣י וַנַּֽחַלְמָ֥ה חֲל֛וֹם אִ֛ישׁ חֲלֹמ֖וֹ חָלָֽמְנוּ׃ כְּפִתְר֥וֹן
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḥāḏ bə·lay·lāh wā·hū ’ă·nî wan·na·ḥal·māh ḥă·lō·wm ’îš ḥă·lō·mōw ḥā·lā·mə·nū kə·p̄iṯ·rō·wn
verses.literal: One night both [the chief baker] and I had dreams . . . [and] each dream . . . had its own meaning

verses.original: נַ֣עַר עִבְרִ֗י וְשָׁ֨ם אִתָּ֜נוּ עֶ֚בֶד לְשַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים וַנְּ֨סַפֶּר־ ל֔וֹ וַיִּפְתָּר־ חֲלֹמֹתֵ֑ינוּ לָ֖נוּ אֶת־ אִ֥ישׁ כַּחֲלֹמ֖וֹ פָּתָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: na·‘ar ‘iḇ·rî wə·šām ’it·tā·nū ‘e·ḇeḏ lə·śar haṭ·ṭab·bā·ḥîm wan·nə·sap·per- lō way·yip̄·tār- ḥă·lō·mō·ṯê·nū lā·nū ’eṯ- ’îš ka·ḥă·lō·mōw pā·ṯār
verses.literal: Now a young Hebrew was there with us a servant of the captain of the guard We told him [our dreams] and he interpreted [them] for us individually . . . . . .

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י לָ֖נוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּֽתַר־ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֑ה אֹתִ֛י הֵשִׁ֥יב עַל־ כַּנִּ֖י וְאֹת֥וֹ תָלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lā·nū ka·’ă·šer pā·ṯar- kên hā·yāh ’ō·ṯî hê·šîḇ ‘al- kan·nî wə·’ō·ṯōw ṯā·lāh
verses.literal: And it happened to us just as he had interpreted . . . . . . - I was restored to my position - and the other man was hanged

verses.original: פַּרְעֹה֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח וַיִּקְרָ֣א אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְרִיצֻ֖הוּ מִן־ הַבּ֑וֹר וַיְגַלַּח֙ וַיְחַלֵּ֣ף שִׂמְלֹתָ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖א אֶל־ פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·yiš·laḥ way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ way·rî·ṣu·hū min- hab·bō·wr way·ḡal·laḥ way·ḥal·lêp̄ śim·lō·ṯāw way·yā·ḇō ’el- par·‘ōh
verses.literal: So Pharaoh sent for . . . - Joseph who was quickly brought out of the dungeon After he had shaved and changed his clothes he went in before Pharaoh

verses.original: פַּרְעֹה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֔מְתִּי אֵ֣ין אֹת֑וֹ וּפֹתֵ֖ר וַאֲנִ֗י שָׁמַ֤עְתִּי לֵאמֹ֔ר עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ תִּשְׁמַ֥ע חֲל֖וֹם לִפְתֹּ֥ר אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·yō·mer ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ḥă·lō·wm ḥā·lam·tî ’ên ’ō·ṯōw ū·p̄ō·ṯêr wa·’ă·nî šā·ma‘·tî lê·mōr ‘ā·le·ḵā tiš·ma‘ ḥă·lō·wm lip̄·tōr ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Pharaoh said to Joseph I had a dream . . . and no - one can interpret it But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it -

verses.original: בִּלְעָדָ֑י יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶת־ וַיַּ֨עַן פַּרְעֹ֛ה לֵאמֹ֖ר אֱלֹהִ֕ים פַּרְעֹֽה׃ שְׁל֥וֹם יַעֲנֶ֖ה אֶת־
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ā·ḏāy yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- way·ya·‘an par·‘ōh lê·mōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm par·‘ōh šə·lō·wm ya·‘ă·neh ’eṯ-
verses.literal: I myself cannot do it Joseph - replied . . . . . . but God { will give } Pharaoh a sound answer -

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֑ף בַּחֲלֹמִ֕י הִנְנִ֥י עֹמֵ֖ד עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ba·ḥă·lō·mî hin·nî ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph In my dream . . . I was standing on the bank of the Nile

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת בְּרִיא֥וֹת בָּשָׂ֖ר וִיפֹ֣ת תֹּ֑אַר עֹלֹת֙ מִן־ הַיְאֹ֗ר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ pā·rō·wṯ bə·rî·’ō·wṯ bā·śār wî·p̄ōṯ tō·’ar ‘ō·lōṯ min- hay·’ōr wat·tir·‘e·nāh bā·’ā·ḥū
verses.literal: - when seven cows well-fed . . . and sleek . . . came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֞ה אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן דַּלּ֨וֹת שֶֽׁבַע־ אֲחֵרוֹת֙ פָּר֤וֹת וְרָע֥וֹת תֹּ֛אַר מְאֹ֖ד וְרַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר עֹל֣וֹת לֹֽא־ רָאִ֧יתִי לָרֹֽעַ׃ כָהֵ֛נָּה בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’a·ḥă·rê·hen dal·lō·wṯ še·ḇa‘- ’ă·ḥê·rō·wṯ pā·rō·wṯ wə·rā·‘ō·wṯ tō·’ar mə·’ōḏ wə·raq·qō·wṯ bā·śār ‘ō·lō·wṯ lō- rā·’î·ṯî lā·rō·a‘ ḵā·hên·nāh bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim
verses.literal: - After them . . . seven other cows sickly ugly . . . and thin . . . came up I have never seen such ugly [cows] in all the land of Egypt

verses.original: הָרַקּ֖וֹת וְהָרָע֑וֹת אֵ֣ת הַפָּר֔וֹת וַתֹּאכַ֙לְנָה֙ שֶׁ֧בַע הַבְּרִיאֹֽת׃ הַפָּר֛וֹת הָרִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: hā·raq·qō·wṯ wə·hā·rā·‘ō·wṯ ’êṯ hap·pā·rō·wṯ wat·tō·ḵal·nāh še·ḇa‘ hab·bə·rî·’ōṯ hap·pā·rō·wṯ hā·ri·šō·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then the thin ugly - cows devoured the seven well-fed cows that were there first

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֣אנָה אֶל־ קִרְבֶּ֗נָה וְלֹ֤א נוֹדַע֙ כִּי־ בָ֣אוּ אֶל־ קִרְבֶּ֔נָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶ֣ן רַ֔ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּתְּחִלָּ֑ה וָאִיקָֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō·nāh ’el- qir·be·nāh wə·lō nō·w·ḏa‘ kî- ḇā·’ū ’el- qir·be·nāh ū·mar·’ê·hen ra‘ ka·’ă·šer bat·tə·ḥil·lāh wā·’î·qāṣ
verses.literal: When they had devoured . . . them, however no one could tell that they had [done so] . . . . . . their appearance was as ugly as it had been before Then I awoke

verses.original: בַּחֲלֹמִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ וָאֵ֖רֶא שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים מְלֵאֹ֥ת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃ עֹלֹ֛ת אֶחָ֖ד בְּקָנֶ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥă·lō·mî wə·hin·nêh wā·’ê·re še·ḇa‘ šib·bo·lîm mə·lê·’ōṯ wə·ṭō·ḇō·wṯ ‘ō·lōṯ ’e·ḥāḏ bə·qā·neh
verses.literal: In my dream . . . I also saw seven heads of grain plump and ripe growing on a single stalk

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים צֹמְח֖וֹת צְנֻמ֥וֹת דַּקּ֖וֹת שְׁדֻפ֣וֹת קָדִ֑ים
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’a·ḥă·rê·hem še·ḇa‘ šib·bo·lîm ṣō·mə·ḥō·wṯ ṣə·nu·mō·wṯ daq·qō·wṯ šə·ḏu·p̄ō·wṯ qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: - After them seven other heads of grain sprouted withered thin and scorched by the east wind

verses.original: הַדַּקֹּ֔ת אֵ֛ת הָשִׁבֳּלִ֣ים וַתִּבְלַ֙עְןָ֙ שֶׁ֥בַע הַטֹּב֑וֹת הַֽשִׁבֳּלִ֖ים וָֽאֹמַר֙ אֶל־ הַֽחַרְטֻמִּ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין מַגִּ֖יד לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: had·daq·qōṯ ’êṯ hå̄·šib·bo·līm wat·tiḇ·la‘·nā še·ḇa‘ haṭ·ṭō·ḇō·wṯ ha·šib·bo·lîm wā·’ō·mar ’el- ha·ḥar·ṭum·mîm wə·’ên mag·gîḏ lî
verses.literal: And the thin - heads of grain swallowed the seven plump ones I told this [dream] to the magicians but no one could explain it to me

verses.original: יוֹסֵף֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה חֲל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶחָ֣ד ה֑וּא אֵ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים הִגִּ֥יד לְפַרְעֹֽה׃ אֲשֶׁ֧ר עֹשֶׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ way·yō·mer ’el- par·‘ōh ḥă·lō·wm par·‘ōh ’e·ḥāḏ hū ’êṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hig·gîḏ lə·p̄ar·‘ōh ’ă·šer ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: At this, Joseph said to Pharaoh The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same . . . - God has revealed to Pharaoh what He is about to do

verses.original: שֶׁ֧בַע הַטֹּבֹ֗ת פָּרֹ֣ת שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הַטֹּבֹ֔ת הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִים֙ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים הֵ֑נָּה חֲל֖וֹם אֶחָ֥ד הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: še·ḇa‘ haṭ·ṭō·ḇōṯ pā·rōṯ še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm hên·nāh wə·še·ḇa‘ haṭ·ṭō·ḇōṯ haš·šib·bo·lîm še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm hên·nāh ḥă·lō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ hū
verses.literal: The seven good cows are seven years . . . and the seven ripe heads of grain are seven years . . . The dreams have the same meaning . . .

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֣בַע הָֽרַקּ֨וֹת וְהָרָעֹ֜ת הַ֠פָּרוֹת הָעֹלֹ֣ת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הָרֵק֔וֹת הַֽשִׁבֳּלִים֙ שְׁדֻפ֖וֹת הַקָּדִ֑ים יִהְי֕וּ שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י רָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·še·ḇa‘ hā·raq·qō·wṯ wə·hā·rā·‘ōṯ hap·pā·rō·wṯ hā·‘ō·lōṯ ’a·ḥă·rê·hen še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm hên·nāh wə·še·ḇa‘ hā·rê·qō·wṯ ha·šib·bo·lîm šə·ḏu·p̄ō·wṯ haq·qā·ḏîm yih·yū še·ḇa‘ šə·nê rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: Moreover, the seven thin ugly cows that came up after them are seven years and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind they are seven years of famine

verses.original: ה֣וּא הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים הֶרְאָ֥ה אֶת־ פַּרְעֹֽה׃ אֲשֶׁ֧ר עֹשֶׂ֖ה
verses.transliteration: hū had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ’el- par·‘ōh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm her·’āh ’eṯ- par·‘ōh ’ă·šer ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: It . . . is just as I said to Pharaoh God has shown - Pharaoh what He is about to do

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים גָּד֖וֹל שָׂבָ֥ע בָּא֑וֹת בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm gā·ḏō·wl śā·ḇā‘ bā·’ō·wṯ bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Behold seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt

verses.original: שֶׁ֜בַע שְׁנֵ֤י רָעָב֙ וְ֠קָמוּ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן כָּל־ הַשָּׂבָ֖ע בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְנִשְׁכַּ֥ח הָרָעָ֖ב אֶת־ וְכִלָּ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: še·ḇa‘ šə·nê rā·‘āḇ wə·qā·mū ’a·ḥă·rê·hen kāl- haś·śā·ḇā‘ bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·niš·kaḥ hā·rā·‘āḇ ’eṯ- wə·ḵil·lāh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: but seven years of famine will follow them Then all the abundance in the land of Egypt will be forgotten and the famine - will devastate the land

verses.original: הַשָּׂבָע֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹֽא־ יִוָּדַ֤ע מִפְּנֵ֛י הַה֖וּא הָרָעָ֥ב אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֑ן כִּֽי־ מְאֹֽד׃ כָבֵ֥ד ה֖וּא
verses.transliteration: haś·śā·ḇā‘ bā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō- yiw·wā·ḏa‘ mip·pə·nê ha·hū hā·rā·‘āḇ ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên kî- mə·’ōḏ ḵā·ḇêḏ hū
verses.literal: The abundance in the land will not be remembered since the famine that follows it - [will be] so severe -

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל כִּֽי־ הַחֲל֛וֹם פַּעֲמָ֑יִם אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה הִשָּׁנ֧וֹת הַדָּבָר֙ נָכ֤וֹן מֵעִ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃ וּמְמַהֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al kî- ha·ḥă·lō·wm pa·‘ă·mā·yim ’el- par·‘ōh hiš·šā·nō·wṯ had·dā·ḇār nā·ḵō·wn mê·‘im hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm la·‘ă·śō·ṯōw ū·mə·ma·hêr
verses.literal: Moreover because the dream was given to Pharaoh in two versions the matter has been decreed by God and He will carry it out shortly

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ פַרְעֹ֔ה יֵרֶ֣א נָב֣וֹן וְחָכָ֑ם אִ֖ישׁ וִישִׁיתֵ֖הוּ עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh p̄ar·‘ōh yê·re nā·ḇō·wn wə·ḥā·ḵām ’îš wî·šî·ṯê·hū ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Now, therefore Pharaoh should look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt

verses.original: פַרְעֹ֔ה יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה וְיַפְקֵ֥ד פְּקִדִ֖ים עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י הַשָּׂבָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: p̄ar·‘ōh ya·‘ă·śeh wə·yap̄·qêḏ pə·qi·ḏîm ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḥim·mêš ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim bə·še·ḇa‘ šə·nê haś·śā·ḇā‘
verses.literal: Let Pharaoh take action and appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth - of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance

verses.original: תַּ֧חַת יַד־ פַּרְעֹ֛ה וְיִקְבְּצ֗וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹ֙כֶל֙ הָאֵ֑לֶּה הַטֹּבֹ֔ת הַשָּׁנִ֣ים הַבָּאֹ֖ת וְיִצְבְּרוּ־ בָ֞ר וְשָׁמָֽרוּ׃ אֹ֥כֶל בֶּעָרִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ yaḏ- par·‘ōh wə·yiq·bə·ṣū ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·ḵel hā·’êl·leh haṭ·ṭō·ḇōṯ haš·šā·nîm hab·bā·’ōṯ wə·yiṣ·bə·rū- ḇār wə·šā·mā·rū ’ō·ḵel be·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: Under the authority of Pharaoh let them collect - all the excess food from these good years that they may come and lay up the grain to be preserved as food in the cities

verses.original: הָאֹ֤כֶל וְהָיָ֨ה לְפִקָּדוֹן֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ לְשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָרָעָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הָאָ֖רֶץ וְלֹֽא־ תִכָּרֵ֥ת בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·ḵel wə·hā·yāh lə·p̄iq·qā·ḏō·wn lā·’ā·reṣ lə·še·ḇa‘ šə·nê hā·rā·‘āḇ ’ă·šer tih·ye·nā bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō- ṯik·kā·rêṯ bā·rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: This food will be a reserve for the land during the seven years of famine - to come upon the land of Egypt Then the country will not perish in the famine

verses.original: הַדָּבָ֖ר וַיִּיטַ֥ב בְּעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ עֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār way·yî·ṭaḇ bə·‘ê·nê p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇə·‘ê·nê kāl- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw
verses.literal: This proposal pleased . . . Pharaoh . . . and all his officials

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ עֲבָדָ֑יו הֲנִמְצָ֣א כָזֶ֔ה אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·yō·mer ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw hă·nim·ṣā ḵā·zeh ’îš ’ă·šer rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm bōw
verses.literal: So Pharaoh asked . . . [them] Can we find anyone like this man in whom the Spirit of God [abides]

verses.original: פַּרְעֹה֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף אַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֛ים אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶת־ כָּל־ זֹ֑את הוֹדִ֧יעַ אֵין־ נָב֥וֹן וְחָכָ֖ם כָּמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·yō·mer ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ō·wṯ·ḵā ’eṯ- kāl- zōṯ hō·w·ḏî·a‘ ’ên- nā·ḇō·wn wə·ḥā·ḵām kā·mō·w·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph Since God - - has made all this known to you there is no one as discerning and wise as you

verses.original: אַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה עַל־ בֵּיתִ֔י וְעַל־ כָּל־ עַמִּ֑י יִשַּׁ֣ק פִּ֖יךָ רַ֥ק הַכִּסֵּ֖א אֶגְדַּ֥ל מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh tih·yeh ‘al- bê·ṯî wə·‘al- kāl- ‘am·mî yiš·šaq pî·ḵā raq hak·kis·sê ’eḡ·dal mim·me·kā
verses.literal: You shall be in charge of my house . . . and all my people are to obey your commands Only with regard to the throne will I be greater than you

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֑ף רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי אֹֽתְךָ֔ עַ֖ל כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·yō·mer ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ rə·’êh nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·ṯə·ḵā ‘al kāl- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Pharaoh also told . . . Joseph vvv I hereby place - you over all the land of Egypt

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֤ה אֶת־ וַיָּ֨סַר טַבַּעְתּוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל יָד֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֖הּ עַל־ יוֹסֵ֑ף יַ֣ד וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְדֵי־ שֵׁ֔שׁ וַיָּ֛שֶׂם הַזָּהָ֖ב רְבִ֥ד עַל־ צַוָּארֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh ’eṯ- way·yā·sar ṭab·ba‘·tōw mê·‘al yā·ḏōw way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯāh ‘al- yō·w·sêp̄ yaḏ way·yal·bêš ’ō·ṯōw biḡ·ḏê- šêš way·yā·śem haz·zā·hāḇ rə·ḇiḏ ‘al- ṣaw·wā·rōw
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh - removed the signet ring from his finger put - it on Joseph’s finger clothed him in garments of fine linen and placed a gold chain around his neck

verses.original: וַיַּרְכֵּ֣ב אֹת֗וֹ הַמִּשְׁנֶה֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ בְּמִרְכֶּ֤בֶת וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ לְפָנָ֖יו אַבְרֵ֑ךְ וְנָת֣וֹן אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar·kêḇ ’ō·ṯōw ham·miš·neh ’ă·šer- lōw bə·mir·ke·ḇeṯ way·yiq·rə·’ū lə·p̄ā·nāw ’aḇ·rêḵ wə·nā·ṯō·wn ’ō·ṯōw ‘al kāl- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: He had Joseph ride - in his second - - chariot with men calling out before him Bow the knee So he placed him over all the land of Egypt

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֛ה וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲנִ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבִלְעָדֶ֗יךָ לֹֽא־ אִ֧ישׁ אֶת־ בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ יָרִ֨ים יָד֛וֹ וְאֶת־ רַגְל֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh way·yō·mer ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ’ă·nî p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇil·‘ā·ḏe·ḵā lō- ’îš ’eṯ- bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim yā·rîm yā·ḏōw wə·’eṯ- raḡ·lōw
verses.literal: And Pharaoh declared to Joseph I am Pharaoh but without your permission no one - in all the land of Egypt shall lift his hand or foot

verses.original: פַרְעֹ֣ה וַיִּקְרָ֨א יוֹסֵף֮ שֵׁם־ צָֽפְנַ֣ת פַּעְנֵחַ֒ וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֣וֹ אֶת־ אָֽסְנַ֗ת בַּת־ פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֛רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֹ֖ן לְאִשָּׁ֑ה יוֹסֵ֖ף וַיֵּצֵ֥א עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: p̄ar·‘ōh way·yiq·rā yō·w·sêp̄ šêm- ṣā·p̄ə·naṯ pa‘·nê·aḥ way·yit·ten- lōw ’eṯ- ’ā·sə·naṯ baṯ- pō·w·ṭî p̄e·ra‘ kō·hên ’ōn lə·’iš·šāh yō·w·sêp̄ way·yê·ṣê ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name vvv Zaphenath-paneah and he gave him - Asenath daughter vvv of Potiphera priest of On to be his wife And Joseph took charge of [all] the land of Egypt

verses.original: וְיוֹסֵף֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעָמְד֕וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרָ֑יִם יוֹסֵף֙ וַיֵּצֵ֤א פַרְעֹ֔ה מִלִּפְנֵ֣י וַֽיַּעְבֹ֖ר בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·sêp̄ šə·lō·šîm ben- šā·nāh bə·‘ā·mə·ḏōw lip̄·nê par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·rā·yim yō·w·sêp̄ way·yê·ṣê p̄ar·‘ōh mil·lip̄·nê way·yaʿ·ḇōr bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Now Joseph was thirty years old . . . when he entered the service . . . of Pharaoh king of Egypt And Joseph left Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout the land of Egypt

verses.original: בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע הָאָ֔רֶץ וַתַּ֣עַשׂ לִקְמָצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·še·ḇa‘ šə·nê haś·śā·ḇā‘ hā·’ā·reṣ wat·ta·‘aś liq·mā·ṣîm
verses.literal: During the seven years of abundance the land brought forth bountifully

verses.original: שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים וַיִּקְבֹּ֞ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹ֣כֶל׀ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ וַיִּתֶּן־ אֹ֖כֶל בֶּעָרִ֑ים הָעִ֛יר נָתַ֥ן אֹ֧כֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׂדֵה־ סְבִיבֹתֶ֖יהָ בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm way·yiq·bōṣ ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·ḵel bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ’ă·šer hā·yū way·yit·ten- ’ō·ḵel be·‘ā·rîm hā·‘îr nā·ṯan ’ō·ḵel ’ă·šer śə·ḏêh- sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯe·hā bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: During those seven years Joseph collected - all the excess food in the land of Egypt - - and stored it in the cities In every city he laid up the food - from the fields around it

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֥ף וַיִּצְבֹּ֨ר בָּ֛ר הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד עַ֛ד כְּח֥וֹל הַיָּ֖ם כִּי־ חָדַ֥ל לִסְפֹּ֖ר כִּי־ אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ way·yiṣ·bōr bār har·bêh mə·’ōḏ ‘aḏ kə·ḥō·wl hay·yām kî- ḥā·ḏal lis·pōr kî- ’ên mis·pār
verses.literal: So Joseph stored up grain in such abundance . . . . . . like the sand of the sea that he stopped keeping track of it for it was beyond measure

verses.original: בְּטֶ֥רֶם שְׁנַ֣ת הָרָעָ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּב֖וֹא שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים יֻלַּד֙ וּלְיוֹסֵ֤ף אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־ פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֽוֹן׃ יָֽלְדָה־ לּוֹ֙
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem šə·naṯ hā·rā·‘āḇ ’ă·šer tā·ḇō·w šə·nê ḇā·nîm yul·laḏ ū·lə·yō·w·sêp̄ ’ā·sə·naṯ baṯ- pō·w·ṭî p̄e·ra‘ kō·hên ’ō·wn yā·lə·ḏāh- lōw
verses.literal: Before the years of famine - arrived two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter vvv of Potiphera priest of On - -

verses.original: יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת־ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שֵׁ֥ם הַבְּכ֖וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ נַשַּׁ֤נִי כָּל־ עֲמָלִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ אָבִֽי׃ בֵּ֥ית
verses.transliteration: yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- way·yiq·rā šêm hab·bə·ḵō·wr mə·naš·šeh kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- naš·ša·nî kāl- ‘ă·mā·lî wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ā·ḇî bêṯ
verses.literal: Joseph - named . . . the firstborn Manasseh saying God - has made me forget all my hardship - and all my father’s household

verses.original: וְאֵ֛ת הַשֵּׁנִ֖י שֵׁ֥ם קָרָ֣א אֶפְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִפְרַ֥נִי בְּאֶ֥רֶץ עָנְיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ haš·šê·nî šêm qā·rā ’ep̄·rā·yim kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm hip̄·ra·nî bə·’e·reṣ ‘ā·nə·yî
verses.literal: - And the second [son] he named . . . Ephraim saying God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction

verses.original: שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ וַתִּכְלֶ֕ינָה
verses.transliteration: še·ḇa‘ šə·nê haś·śā·ḇā‘ ’ă·šer hā·yāh bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wat·tiḵ·le·nāh
verses.literal: When the seven years of abundance - - in the land of Egypt came to an end

verses.original: שֶׁ֣בַע שְׁנֵ֤י הָרָעָב֙ לָב֔וֹא וַתְּחִלֶּ֜ינָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יוֹסֵ֑ף אָמַ֣ר וַיְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בְּכָל־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת הָ֥יָה לָֽחֶם׃ וּבְכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם
verses.transliteration: še·ḇa‘ šə·nê hā·rā·‘āḇ lā·ḇō·w wat·tə·ḥil·le·nāh ka·’ă·šer yō·w·sêp̄ ’ā·mar way·hî rā·‘āḇ bə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ hā·yāh lā·ḥem ū·ḇə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim
verses.literal: the seven years of famine . . . began just as Joseph had said And although there was famine in every country there was food throughout the land of Egypt

verses.original: וַתִּרְעַב֙ כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם הָעָ֛ם וַיִּצְעַ֥ק אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה לַלָּ֑חֶם פַּרְעֹ֤ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְכָל־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְכ֣וּ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃ אֲשֶׁר־ יֹאמַ֥ר לָכֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wat·tir·‘aḇ kāl- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim hā·‘ām way·yiṣ·‘aq ’el- par·‘ōh lal·lā·ḥem par·‘ōh way·yō·mer lə·ḵāl miṣ·ra·yim lə·ḵū ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ta·‘ă·śū ’ă·šer- yō·mar lā·ḵem
verses.literal: When extreme hunger came to all the land of Egypt and the people cried out to Pharaoh for food [he] told all the Egyptians Go to Joseph and do whatever he tells you

verses.original: וְהָרָעָ֣ב הָיָ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶֽת־ וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּשְׁבֹּ֣ר לְמִצְרַ֔יִם הָֽרָעָ֖ב וַיֶּחֱזַ֥ק בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rā·‘āḇ hā·yāh ‘al kāl- pə·nê hā·’ā·reṣ yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- way·yip̄·taḥ kāl- ’ă·šer bā·hem way·yiš·bōr lə·miṣ·ra·yim hā·rā·‘āḇ way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: When the famine had spread over all the land Joseph - opened up all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt

verses.original: וְכָל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בָּ֣אוּ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֑ף מִצְרַ֔יְמָה לִשְׁבֹּ֖ר כִּֽי־ הָרָעָ֖ב חָזַ֥ק בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ bā·’ū ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ miṣ·ray·māh liš·bōr kî- hā·rā·‘āḇ ḥā·zaq bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And every nation came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain because the famine was severe over all the earth
